inclusion_criteria.value: We included patients in whom a decision to initiate venovenous ECMO had already been made and met the following criteria: 1) met the diagnostic criteria of Berlin definition for ARDS; 2) cause of ARDS was pneumonia; and 3) had one of following disease-severity criteria despite optimum mechanical ventilation (tidal volume 6 mL/kg of predicted body weight, PEEP ≥ 10 cm H2O, Fio2 ≥ 0.8) and use of various rescue therapies: ratio of Pao2 to Fio2 less than or equal to 80 mm Hg; or an arterial blood pH less than 7.20 with a Paco2 greater than 60 mm Hg, with respiratory rate increased to 35 breaths per minute and Pplat less than or equal to 30 cm H2O.

provenance.quote: We included patients in whom a decision to initiate venovenous ECMO had already been made and met the following criteria: 1) met the diagnostic criteria of Berlin definition for ARDS (13); 2) cause of ARDS was pneumonia (Appendix S1...); and 3) had one of following disease-severity criteria despite optimum mechanical ventilation (tidal volume 6 mL/kg of predicted body weight [PBM], PEEP ≥ 10 cm H2O, Fio2 ≥ 0.8) and use of various rescue therapies: ratio of Pao2 to Fio2 less than or equal to 80 mm Hg; or an arterial blood pH less than 7.20 with a Paco2 greater than 60 mm Hg, with respiratory rate increased to 35 breaths per minute and Pplat less than or equal to 30 cm H2O.

exclusion_criteria.value: Patients with any of the following were excluded as follows: 1) age less than 18 years old; 2) patients had been on high pressure (Ppeak > 35 cm H2O) and high Fio2 greater than 0.8 ventilation for greater than 7 days; 3) patients already suffering pulmonary barotraumas; 4) had a contraindication to heparinization; 5) had an irreversible neurologic injury; or 6) severe chronic lung disease with life expectancy less than 6 months.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS: all patients met Berlin criteria for severe ARDS (PaO2/FiO2 ≤80). Obesity: mean BMI ~24 kg/m2, non-obese. Timing: intervention started at enrolment, so timing in illness is unclear. PTP target: end-expiratory Ptp 0-5 cmH2O, an absolute positive target.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No other reports of this cohort identified. Registration NCT02439151 is unique.
unclear_items: Ptp computation method not explicitly described; assumed to be absolute subtraction (PL = Paw - Pes) based on citation to Talmor, but not confirmed.
Timing subgroup unclear because intervention began at enrolment, not clearly related to intubation or ICU admission.
Tidal volume target in Ptp-guided group not in methods; inferred from discussion as 3 mL/kg PBW.
Baseline sex (female) not reported; only male counts given, so sex_female omitted to avoid derivation.
6-month mortality timepoint: days left null because 6 months is not a fixed day; label_verbatim '6 mo' used.
data_only_in_figure: Time course of respiratory mechanics in Figure 2 (Table S1 in supplement, not available)
extraction_flags.general_notes: Study is a parallel-arm RCT of Ptp-guided ventilation vs ELSO lung rest strategy in severe ARDS on VV-ECMO. The intervention used esophageal balloon manometry to guide PEEP (end-expiratory Ptp 0-5 cmH2O), meeting the balloon_guided_peep_titration criterion. The paper does not describe the esophageal balloon device or calibration methods. Other complications from Table 2 (e.g., bleeding, mechanical complications) not extracted as they are not central to the review question.
